links.outcome: Sensitivity and NPV of urgency classification of epilepsy portal messages versus neurologist consensus
links.effect: Unanimous standard: 5 of 6 models had perfect sensitivity and NPV. Majority standard: GPT-5 sensitivity 0.98, NPV 1.00; GPT-OSS 20B sensitivity only 0.57 (specificity 0.95).
links.quote: Under the Unanimous reference standard, five of six models achieved perfect sensitivity and NPV, indicating safe rule-out performance.

unlisted_practices: Comparing cloud-hosted versus on-premise open-weight LLMs for urgent message screening, including PHI containment and cost trade-offs

screen.reason: Retrospective comparative evaluation of multiple cloud vs on-premise LLMs for screening urgent patient portal messages against neurologist annotations; evaluates model triage performance without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
